# GTOCX small branch fixture

`small-tree.txt` retains the 3 mothers, 12 pods, 2 fast ships and the first
directly rooted settler leg of the organizer-published NUDT&XSCC final solution.
It has 15 settlements. It is a derived test subset, not the competition's winning
submission. The original unchanged file, its source URL and hash remain under
`references/gtocx/`. Neither tests nor reference submissions enter Docker builds.
